title: Status
responsibility: Renders verification verdicts, compact icons, translated badges and cancellable run status with one shared implementation.

inputs.name: Status.passed
inputs.description: Controls whether verdict mode is proven; only literal true counts as a pass. It defaults to false, and other modes do not use it to choose their status.

inputs.name: Status.variant
inputs.description: Selects the rendering mode and defaults to verdict. The allowed modes are verdict, icon, badge, and run.

inputs.name: Status.status
inputs.description: Supplies the icon or badge status and defaults to unknown. Icon mode shows a check only for verified; badge mode passes the string to the report-status translator.

inputs.name: Status.reason
inputs.description: Supplies the explanation shown in icon mode and defaults to an empty string. An empty reason becomes No verification recorded for this revision.
examples: No verification recorded for this revision.
The capture does not match this revision.

inputs.name: Status.active
inputs.description: Controls whether run mode shows the Cancel run button and defaults to false. It has an effect only when run mode has a truthy label.

inputs.name: Status.cancel
inputs.description: Provides the callback for the Cancel run button and defaults to undefined. It is only attached when run mode has a truthy label and active is true; callback errors propagate.

inputs.name: Status.children
inputs.description: Provides custom run content and defaults to undefined. Run mode renders it instead of the label when both the snippet and a truthy label are present; rendering errors propagate.

inputs.name: Status.label
inputs.description: Supplies the displayed label and defaults to undefined; verdict mode derives Full coverage passed or Verification failed when it is absent. Run mode renders nothing unless the label is truthy.

inputs.name: Status.reasons
inputs.description: Supplies ordered reasons for a non-passing verdict tooltip and defaults to an empty array. A proven verdict hides these reasons.

inputs.name: Status.framed
inputs.description: Controls the outline around the verdict icon and defaults to false. It affects verdict mode only.

inputs.name: Status.bare
inputs.description: Accepts a compatibility boolean and defaults to undefined. The value is not read when rendering; verdict mode always draws only the icon.

outputs.name: Status
outputs.description: Produces markup for the selected verdict, icon, badge, or run mode. Verdict mode treats only passed === true as a pass and exposes ordered reasons in an accessible tooltip; icon mode shows its explanation while focused, hovered, or activated, badge mode translates status, and run mode renders only for a truthy label with cancellation available when active.

errors.name: Caller rendering or callback error
errors.description: Errors raised while rendering the supplied run snippet or invoking the cancellation callback propagate without being caught or converted.
